source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of acid rain (PDF 238-239).

blocks.text: Tezabi barish (acid rain) aisi barish hai jis mein sanati aaloodgi se bane nitric acid aur sulphuric acid ka amezah ho. Aam barish ke pani ka pH ghule hue carbonic acid ki wajah se taqreeban 5.6 ya zyada hota hai; 5.6 se kam pH wali barish tezabi barish hai. Yeh fiza mein sulphur oxides (SOx) aur nitrogen oxides (NOx) se hoti hai, jo aksar sanati aaloodgi se aate aur pani aur oxygen se mil kar sulphuric acid aur nitric acid banate hain:

Jab tezabi barish mitti par girti hai to H+ ions mitti ke zarrat par jure zaruri ghizai ions jaise calcium (Ca2+), magnesium (Mg2+) aur potassium (K+) ki jagah le lete hain; yeh reas kar beh jate aur paudon ko nahi milte. Saath hi yeh aluminium (Al3+) jaisi zehreeli dhaton ko zyada hal-pazeer bana deti hai; paudon ki jarein inhein jazb kar ke nuqsan uthati hain, jis se ghizai ajza lene ki salahiyat kam, barhotri sust aur paidawar kam hoti hai:

items: K+-soil + H+ -> H+-soil + K+ (potassium ka reasna)

blocks.alt: Oopar: karkhane ki chimney SO2 aur NOx chhorti, jo badal tak uth kar oxidise hoti aur tezab boondon mein ghulte; H2SO4 aur HNO3 wali barish (pH 5.6 se kam) girti; saath banne ki do equations likhi hain. Neeche: K+, Ca2+ aur Al3+ ions thame mitti ke zarre par H+ hamla karta; teen equations K+, Ca2+ aur Al3+ ka hatna dikhati; matan batata ke ghizai ajza reaste, zehreela Al3+ jaron ko nuqsan deta, aur jheelon mein Al3+ machhli ke galphare band karta.
blocks.caption: Tezabi barish: banna aur asraat (Figure 32.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Tezabi barish izafi H+ ions lati hai. Yeh mufeed K+, Ca2+ aur Mg2+ ions ko mitti se hata dete hain taake barish unhein baha le jaye, aur nuqsan-deh Al3+ ko azad karte hain.

blocks.text: Paudon par seedhi girne wali tezabi barish patton ko nuqsan pohancha kar khushk kar sakti aur paude ko bimari aur mahol ke dabao ke liye kamzor bana sakti hai. Yeh nitrogen fixation aur ghizai ajza ki jazbiyat kam kar ke soybean aur gandum ki paidawar ghata sakti hai. Yeh mitti ke khurdbeeni jandaron ko bhi nuqsan de kar qudrati ghizai chakkaron aur organic maddah ke galne-sarne ko bigar sakti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Tezabi jheelon mein machhliyan kyun marti hain? Tezabi barish mitti se Al3+ azad karti hai, jo machhli ke galphare (gills) band kar ke oxygen ki jazbiyat kam karta hai, aur machhliyan dam ghutne se mar jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Tezabi barish mitti ko kam zarkhez kyun banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ke H+ ions mitti ke zarrat par K+, Ca2+ aur Mg2+ ki jagah lete hain to yeh ghizai ajza beh jate hain, aur yeh zehreela Al3+ azad karti hai jo jaron ko nuqsan deta hai.

items: Tezabi barish: pH 5.6 se kam; SOx aur NOx se (H2SO4, HNO3).
H+ K+, Ca2+, Mg2+ reasata aur zehreela Al3+ azad karta.
Patte, paidawar, mitti ke jarasim aur machhliyan mutasir.
